definitions.explanation: The number one when counting small objects or general items.
Used in casual speech to indicate age difference.

examples.japanese: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一個|いっこ}⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: They're selling them for 100 yen each.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一個|いっこ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There was only one left here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一個|いっこ}⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧だ。
{一個|いっこ}⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have a junior who's one year younger.

examples.japanese: {一個|いっこ}⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{気|き}が{合|あ}う→気が合う：22839_kigaau⟧。
examples.english: We get along because we're only one year apart.

notes:
{一個|いっこ} is a very common counter for objects.

SENSE 1 - COUNTING OBJECTS:
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧{一個|いっこ}: one egg
- {一個|いっこ}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: one at a time
- {一個|いっこ}⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧: per piece

SENSE 2 - AGE DIFFERENCE (CASUAL):
- {一個|いっこ}⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: one year older
- {一個|いっこ}⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧: one year younger
- {二個|にこ}⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: two years older

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- {一個|いっこ}、{二個|にこ}、{三個|さんこ}...
- ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ is one of the most versatile counters in Japanese

USAGE:
The age difference usage ({一個|いっこ}⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧/⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧) is casual/colloquial.
